newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-KUIPER BLASTS BOLAND TO WIN OVER F.STATE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-KUIPER BLASTS BOLAND TO WIN OVER F.STATE.

text.p: A brilliant six-studded innings of 117 not out by Adrian Kuiper carried Boland to a fine five- wicket victory over Free State in their Supersport Series cricket match in Paarl on Monday.

Boland skipper Kuiper, who hit nine sixes and eight fours in his 179-ball innings, was ably supported by Andrew Wessels who scored a watchful 56 not out in a match-winning, unbroken sixth- wicket partnership of 165.
The pair came together with Boland teetering on 91 for five on Sunday evening after they had been set to make 255 for victory.
They required a further 109 when play resumed on Monday, but the combination of Kuiper's belligerance and Wessels' patience guided them smoothly to their target.
Kosie Venter could not add to his match haul of ten wickets as he and slow left-armer Nicky Boje were repeatedly picked off for boundaries by Kuiper.
He raised his century by thumping Venter over deep midwicket for his eighth six as his policy of unchecked aggression paid off.
He was dropped just once, on 104, when only 18 were needed for victory and Nico Pretorius spilled a straightforward chance on midwicket boundary.
The performance was made all the more poignant for Kuiper by the fact that it may have come in his final first-class match for Boland.
He delivered the club an ultimatum earlier this month when he said he wanted to see more experienced players brought to the province or he would quit.
Bowling: Pretorius 5-3-9-0, Cilliers 14-3-31-1, Venter 25-3-109-4, Bakkes 2-0-9-0, Boje 22-10-68-0, Cronje 12-5-11-0, Dippenaar 1-0-8-0
Result: Boland won by five wickets
Points: Boland 17 pts, Free State seven
